items.title: A subset of a spectral space closed in the constructible topology is spectral
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a subset of a spectral space which is closed in the constructible topology is again spectral (author lemma at source lines 4643-4649, label lemma-spectral-sub). The proof (source lines 4651-4675) proves sobriety through the generic point of a closure, obtains quasi-compactness from closedness in the constructible topology and identifies a basis of quasi-compact opens with the traces of quasi-compact opens of the ambient space (proof lines 4651-4674). The sobriety step and the description of the basis are the substance. H3.
